description: The index of every indexable page of PolarJay with its URL, title, description and Markdown twin. Optionally filtered by words in the title or description, or by language.

limit.description: How many pages to return, default 50. count is the total that match.

locale.description: Answer language: es, en. Default en. A regional form such as en-US is read as en. A language the site does not publish is rejected with the list of the ones it does.

query.description: Words to look for in the title, description or path

name: list_pages
title: Pages of the website
